SELECT principals.id 
FROM principals 
WHERE principals.token_hash = ?
BEGIN IMMEDIATE

SELECT task_extractions.task_id, task_extractions.principal_id, JSON_EXTRACT(task_extractions.snapshot, ?) AS kind, JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(task_extractions.snapshot, ?)), ?) AS source 
FROM task_extractions 
WHERE task_extractions.app_id = ?

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(app_drafts.candidate, ?)), ?)), ?) AS kind, JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(app_drafts.candidate, ?)), ?)), ?) AS source, JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(app_drafts.candidate, ?)), ?) AS run 
FROM app_drafts 
WHERE app_drafts.id = ?

SELECT runs.id, runs.principal_id, runs.project_id, runs.runtime_id, runs.resource_refs, runs.status 
FROM runs 
WHERE runs.id = ? AND runs.principal_id = ?

SELECT projects.id, projects.owner_id, projects.runtime_id, projects.name 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = ? AND projects.owner_id = ?

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(run_contracts.snapshot, ?)), ?) AS resource, JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(run_contracts.snapshot, ?)), ?)) AS refs, JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(run_contracts.snapshot, ?)), ?)), ?) AS material 
FROM run_contracts 
WHERE run_contracts.run_id = ?

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_intents.request, ?)), ?) AS anon_1 
FROM operation_intents JOIN operations ON operations.id = operation_intents.operation_id 
WHERE operations.run_id = ? AND operations.tool_ref IN (?, ?)

SELECT projects.id, projects.owner_id, projects.runtime_id, projects.name 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = ? AND projects.owner_id = ?

SELECT resources.id 
FROM resources 
WHERE resources.id = ? AND resources.project_id = ?

SELECT grants.id, grants.principal_id, grants.project_id, grants.resource_id, grants.tool_ref, grants.expires_at, grants.revision, grants.revoked 
FROM grants 
WHERE grants.principal_id = ? AND grants.project_id = ? AND grants.resource_id = ? AND grants.tool_ref = ? ORDER BY grants.id
